description.en:
The sea is a lawless zone, plagued by man-eating sea monsters and pirates. In such a sea, there exists the world’s strongest naval admiral, feared by all. With wealth, power, and looks, he has one secret: His true identity is a siren!

Living in a world where other species have disappeared, he hides his identity, but when he meets the sea-loving Cella, she uncovers his secret.

“Siren, huh? I like mackerel, tuna, flatfish, stingrays… basically all marine fish.”
“…Fish.”
She’s a strange woman who, despite her eccentricities, hides her powers.
He decides to hire her to keep an eye on her, but…
“What if I want to become a beach bum?”
“What’s that?”
“It’s simple. I don’t work, I just lounge around, eating and doing nothing—basically a rich layabout. That’s my dream, to live like that by the beach.”
“……”
“If you hire me, I won’t work. I’ll just lay on the couch like a seal, patting my belly.”
“That sounds fun. I’ve never hired a sea seal before.”

His nonchalant answer leaves Cella flustered.
Wait, this isn’t what she planned? She never intended to get involved with the admiral. He is, after all, the final boss from the original work!

Unintentionally treating his illness and uncovering his true identity, she decides to escape to a beach resort for a peaceful life.

“This is interesting.”

The admiral, with his fiery gaze, looks out at the sea and orders:

“Chase the ferry to Maltana. Now.”
description.ru: Обычный студент факультета океанологии Селла реинкарнирует в качестве героини новеллы. Она начинает вмешиваться в историю оригинала, чтобы осуществить свои мечты, пусть даже только в рамках романа. Единственное, чего она боится? Встречи с тёмным адмиралом Эллаймом. Но тут, обнаруживается шокирующая правда: правитель беззаконных морей на самом деле легендарная русалка, сирена. Неожиданно добрый и манящий, он нуждается в Селле, чтобы контролировать свою переполняющую магическую силу и выжить. В волнах судьбы разворачивается освежающий, греющий сердце морской роман!

description.en:
Byeolha Kim was happily married… until she wasn’t anymore. 

Betrayed by her best friend, she is no longer the bubbly, innocent girl she used to be. However, everything changes once again in an accident that causes her to reality-shift. Now she is stuck in a mysterious but familiar world, and it doesn’t help that her back-stabbing, husband-stealing ex-friend is there with her. 

Will she be able to weave her own happy reality, or is she doomed by the narrative?

biography.en: A webnovelist.

description.en: Jo SeungHoon is a newbie salaryman working at a game company for the past year. He is sent to the Human Resources Department, to work under a boss who's a devil in human disguise. The company grows quickly, but there is a hidden side to this growth. What is the devil's true goal, and how will the people respond when they realize it?

“Doyoon is a high school senior who struggles to pay a money fee that his school bully Kim Yuchan demands from him every week. Until one day, he is asked by an acquaintance that he used to play online games with and who also is a game developer to play an Indie Game made by him. When Doyoon started to play the game he was surprised to see that the Main character in the game was in the same situation as him in his real life. In the game he was tasked to choose multiple options for different scenarios, and in one of those, just for curiosity about how that would’ve been, he chose to get a brutal revenge on his bully Kim Yuchan. When the next day came after playing that game, Doyoon realized that his life was taking the same course as the events that he played in the game…Which means that it seems that the game has turned Doyoon’s life into whatever happens in that multiple options game.
description.ko:
같은 학교의 유찬에게 매주 상납금을 바치며 괴로운 나날을 보내는 도윤.
어느 날, 온라인 게임에서 만난 게임 개발자인 지인에게 어떤 인디게임을 받게 되고
도윤은 게임의 주인공이 자신과 똑같은 처지에 처해있다는 사실에 놀란다.
혹시나 하는 마음 반, 호기심 반에 괴롭히는 자신을 유찬에게 잔인한 복수를 게임에서 선택하고 다음 날을 맞는다.
도윤의 일상은 게임과 똑같이 흘러가기 시작하고...

description.en: An unknown man in the military visiting room and a woman who kissed him out of anger who witnessed her cheating boyfriend, with In-ha's help, she wrote a novel based on that experience and made a splendid debut, but her joy fell into a slump. I'm a romance writer, but I can't write about romance! In front of such a soft heart, our debut muse, Inha, appeared again! Yeorin suddenly lets Inha, who is unemployed, move into her share house her. As soon as Inha enters the house, Yeorin receives a proposal for a project from Seok-Hyun, the person in charge, and the down payment is 300 million won! However, she must write a romance novel!
Cheon Mudeok knows two things: fighting and loyalty to his friends. Will he be able to graduate safely? Or is this the birth of a legend?

A breathtaking action fantasy of Gods walking a treacherous tightrope across the undefined border between Good and Evil!! Or, put simply, just NONSENSE.  
  
Note: This project was begun by an amateur manhwaga on Naver who decided to restart Trump from the beginning because of it failing to receive attention by the Naver publishers. Then when it was picked up by Naver, Trump was once again republished and the author changed her professional name from sinceby1991 to Lee Chae Eun. Both previous versions were discontinued. The "official" Trump being published is linked below as a related series. This version had 36 chapters.

Eunja is a young woman who was inspired to become a social worker after her mother died of dementia
Her life as a social worker is fulfilling, but she has trouble with people who disrespect the elders
An inspiring tale of how Eunja's regrets about her mother's death fuel her to become a social worker

Princess of romance, Hwi-Kyung. The handsome, wolf-like, Three Musketeer guys who run to Hwi-Kyung wherever she is.  
They make a secret promise without Hwi-Kyung knowing. If one of them starts to love Hwi-Kyung, their friendship will shatter.  
A no-love oath.  
The prince of confidence, Yoon Suh-Rin's, charm!  
Te-Ri, who became a two-timer because he loved Hwi-Kyung!  
And the one who hid his love for Hwi-Kyung's happiness, the charismatic Jo Hwan-Sung's sad love story!

From Loyal Kiss:  
Every time you sent me one of your fake smiles, my fists clench automatically.  
If I had a gun in my pocket, I would have shot you.  
  
Tied by a secret that keeps him from loving the one he loves, he is Choi EunJo.  
The handsome and much beloved idol, he is Im Sol - no girl can resist his killer smile.  
  
But for Narae, all she feels is disgust.  
Bam!!  
Where will Narae's Love Bullet fly?

This is a story of fairies, told in a place without a name. Once in every 100 years, a young fairy from in the deep bush must come to the human world to become an adult. They use 'power' to attract a human male, to fall in love with. Afterward, the man dies. But, the fairy to whom he'd given his love will grow wings and become a beautiful adult.   
  
This fantasy romance story starts off with a fairy of Grass, named Grassbee, going to the human world to become an adult. Will she be able to attract a human male? Will she be able to become an adult fairy and get fairy wings? Magic can only do so much…

description.en: The development of <Marigold in a Box>, a virtual reality game, is stopped after an unfortunate accident. Sun-ah can't help but be sad and disappointed as the manager of the development team. She decides to log on to the game as a farewell... But she can't customize her character? She can't even log out?! She is forced into becoming the protagonist of the game, Cloe Marigold. What choice does she have? She just has to kill herself and reach the 'dead ending' in the game. Then, she'll be free! However, due to interfering NPC characters, she always fails. She almost makes it out once... but she doesn't. Now, there's only one way to get out. She must beat the game.

description.en:
"Commoner girl."

Olivia could never get used to those loathsome words.

Her titles, such as "first female university student’" and "valedictorian," were meaningless. Then one day, the Herod Royal Family presented her with Noah Astrid, the "Flower of the Royal Family." Though it seemed to be a flower full of poison, she had no choice but to take it. 

And she couldn’t help but love this flower, the first she had ever held.

Because it was like salvation.

Jin-Hung has an unusual power. She can see ghosts and make them disappear with one word! One day walking on the streets, she sees a guy trying to kill himself. To stop him she runs toward him. Later she finds out that he is a ghost, but not just any ghost- her middle school crush, Shin-Yi! Shin-Yi unknowingly starts to follow Jin-Hung around her school and then they bump into another ghost- Shin-Yi's best friend Yi-Ryeong. How did they end up dead and why is Yi-Ryeong follow Jin-Hung saying that he's her guardian?  
  
(Source: Fateful-Encounters)

(If I can make money, I will do anything.)  
  
I can sell (give up on) my love, or risk my life.  
You want to use me as a tool to revenge your little brother [or sister]?  
Here, I will be used. Buy me.  
I am very expensive.  
  
Eun Hyool, you said you will do anything if you get paid?  
I will buy every single piece of you.  
From now on, you are my slave.  
But, I will refuse your heart.  
  
These two are getting used to each other by endlessly running against each other.  
Love that formed through quarrels is risky like a flower at the end of a cliff!

description.en:
"I will destroy my organization with my own hands."


Lee Gangjin was the ultimate skilled gangster in the dark world. But he is betrayed and killed by his most cherished younger brother, Jo Dooyoung.

At that moment of death, he awakens in the body of high school student Lee Kangjin, who had ended his life due to being overwhelmed by school violence.

Meanwhile, to maintain the faction, the Gangjin Faction starts an Underworld Audition, and delinquent teenagers are enthusiastic about joining the Gangjin Faction.

Filled with remorse, Gangjin resolves to undo everything and personally eliminate the Gangjin Faction he established.
'"Jin-ah', a banker who lives a realistic life, and 'Walnut', an unknown parrot who pursues an ideal life. The story unfolds as the two dramas meet"

Seda has it tough. Her school has suddenly gone from a girl's only school to co-ed. Plus, her father could be described as a Korean Scrooge.   
But with the boys coming into her life, being late for the bus isn't the only thing she needs to worry about.  
  
[PL] Seda ma ciężko w życiu. Jej szkoła z tylko dla dziewcząt zmieniła się w koedukacyjną, a jej tata może być uważany za koreańskiego Scrooge’a. Ale kiedy chłopcy pojawią się w jej życiu, spóźnienie się na autobus nie będzie jej największym problemem.

"A spell to change the genre of your life!” Yeah, that’d be nice. So far, Juwon’s existence has been pretty ordinary: a boring daily routine with zero romance to speak of. Then one day, he sees a movie where the main character’s life suddenly turns into a rom-com. Things have been weird ever since. Surely it can’t be down to the movie, but… guys just won’t leave him alone! His childhood friend, the cute barista from the coffee shop, his mean classmate, AND his first love?! Four hotties, all at once! Now Juwon stands at a crossroads. Which way will he turn? A new series from the creator of “Can't Take My Eyes Off You!"

No one remembers when it was the first time to see a monster in Seoul, Korea. Also nobody remembers who was the first to meet an angel here.

Now, a new job called Hunter seems promising.

Yoo Jaya, who lost his parent by one of the monsters was able to survive by the help of the Arc-angel , Metatron.
Metatron saves his life twice- but the consequence was the shortening lifespan of Jaya.

Jaya and Metatron re-start to take revenge of the monsters!

3rd Lezhin Comics World Comic Contest Winner.

Kang Ho, a passionate firefighter, dedicated everything to his mission of rescuing many people out of a sense of duty. However, what he get back was a burned and brutally murdered wife, and the betrayal from the world. Determined to seek revenge in his own way, even though he saved them, he decides to reclaim the lives of those he deems unworthy of living a new life. He then raises his daughter, Mina, to become a ruthless killer in order to carry out his vengence. As time passes, 10 years later, Kang Ho believes that his daughter has become a complete killer as a high school student. He assigns her the first mission to retrieve the life of a designated target…
A boy named Komang learns kung fu and meet many friends along the way.

At night, one by one, they die. Until they find fault with each other. "I will execute the final suspect." 

After high school, each of them was living a normal life in their own place, in their respective places. But one day, they all  are kidnapped by a mysterious man, and when they wake up, they are being held captive in a run-down youth hostel. The group is told that they will be executing one suspect a day, and they are asked to vote to find the culprit......Can the group find the suspect and escape unharmed?

A blinding flash of light, and his village was gone. Lowe vows to reach the floating Island of the Gods, but first, he must venture into a world ruled by a ranking system and claw his way to the top. Trained by the world’s strongest knight, he embarks on a quest to become the top ranker, battling fearsome beasts and ruthless rivals to uncover the truth and save his loved ones.
description.it:
Un lampo di luce accecante e il suo villaggio è scomparso.
Lowe giura di raggiungere l'Isola galleggiante degli Dei, ma prima deve avventurarsi in un mondo governato da un sistema di ranking e raggiungere la vetta. Addestrato dal cavaliere più forte del mondo, intraprende una missione per diventare top ranker, combattendo bestie temibili e rivali spietati per scoprire la verità e salvare coloro che ama.

title.en: Even If the Flowers Are Gone

description.en:
At the end of the cold continent, Onran is a warm country ruled by the gods. Inok, a foreigner, can't forget the appearance of the king he saw as a child, so he applied for and passed the Royal Guard, and became an escort.

And on Hwanonjeol, Onran's biggest holiday, he finally meets the king, Raan, but Raan has changed a lot, unlike Inok's memory...
description.ko:
추운 대륙의 끝, 신이 다스리는 따뜻한 나라 온란. 이민족인 이녹은 어린시절 본 왕의 모습을 잊지 못해 왕궁호위대에 지원, 합격하여 호위가 된다.
그리고 온란 최대의 명절인 환온절에 드디어 왕인 라안과 대면하게 되지만 라안은 이녹의 기억과 다르게 너무나 많이 변해 있었는데….

The emotionless high school student was adopted by the family he is living with. He is not only mistreated by his family but also bullied by his classmates in school. One day, he picked up a strange book called 'the second dream' and since then, he entered into a lucid dream of a game world when he fell asleep. Later in school, he found that he was not the only one that had the book.

I picked up a puppy, but it turned out it's not just a puppy." What if the puppy you picked up off the street turned out to actually be a man, one with an amazing face and physique? Jion accidentally became the savior of one puppy but the next day, the puppy was nowhere to be found, with a tall man lying next to her instead. Then accidentally kissing turns him back into a puppy, and then back into a man. A confusing cohabitation between her and the world's cutest puppy and at the same time, the world's sexiest man begins.

Myojin was once a cursed child who managed to work his way up to being a God of the Celestial Realm. For the sin of killing his fellow celestial beings, he was cast down to Earth to live – and, eventually, die – among humans.  
  
But the wheels of fate turn in the oddest of ways, for one day the baby son of a celestial deity and mortal man ends up falling into Myojin's custody. Believing that showing kindness to the child will help him be accepted back into the Celestial Realm, Myojin takes him in. But can this man, whose heart has become hardened towards both suffering and joy, rear a healthy, wholesome child?

description.fr:
« J’aurais préféré vivre en oubliant tout ça. »
Malgré tous ses efforts, Hyeon-gu se retrouve affecté en province et doit rentrer dans sa ville natale. Là, il croise à nouveau, pour la première fois en dix ans, son ancien camarade de lycée Moon-sang, qui gère désormais la librairie Jeongmun Seolim, leur ancien repaire.

En le revoyant, les souvenirs de leur tout premier baiser, soigneusement enfouis, refont surface… et son cœur recommence à battre.

description.en:
Yong-cheol wanted to go to college, but gave up due to family problems. She accidentally found a student ID, and decided to disguise herself as "Lee Chaeyeon," the owner of the ID, and goes to Hankuk University like a normal student. 

"I want to make a friends and get close to the seniors and taste the campus life that I wanted!" 

"Wait.. The owner of the I.D that I thought had dropped out, appeared!?" 

A breathtaking, thrilling fake student begins!

우연한 계기로 발견한 학생증으로 얼떨결에 한국대 신입생으로 위장했다!

description.en:
A girl creates her story in an empty, deserted space.  
  
A different type of creation story.

Pretty boy-crazy 5th grader, Myung-Ee, doesn’t really want to waste her time on class president, Yu-Da Lee, who doesn’t meet any of her requirements for eye candy… (Too short! Too young!) But when Yu-Da disappears one day, no one except Myung-Ee seems to remember him. Teased about her “invisible boyfriend,” Myung-Ee transfers high schools five years later in search of greener pastures (read: prettier boys). Only she finds herself face-to-face with some of the most beautiful boys she’s ever seen…and Yu-Da, now a class secretary, who doesn’t remember anything about her! Startled by this new development, Myung-Ee’s positively floored when she learns that she and Yu-Da are “Earth rabbits” being hunted by a clan of shape-shifting foxes, some of whom comprise the very student council that surrounds Yu-Da! Will Myung-Ee be able to save Yu-Da from these foxes in sheep’s clothing?

What if you were fated to be murdered in every life? 

Living in a small countryside town, Nogyung Lee thinks her biggest problem is her unrequited crush on her childhood friend. But Nogyung is cursed destined to be slain by the same villagers every time she's reborn. 

With no memories of her previous lives, she must unravel the mysteries of her village and the legends surrounding it in order to stay alive. Can Nogyung finally break the curse or is she fated to relive this tragedy forever?
description.ko:
전생은 과연 현재 삶에 어떤 의미가 있을까? 아무 상관이 없는 것일까. 아니, 어쩌면 운명처럼 전생의 관계들은 반복되는 것이 아닐까.

전생의 업보로 환생할 때마다 마을 사람들에게 죽임 당하는 운명의 소녀 녹영, 녹영이 환생할 때마다 마을 사람들은 본능적으로 그녀 주변으로 모여든다. 그리고 그들이 겪었던 전생의 사건들은 마치 저주처럼 그 옛날 그대로 반복된다. 녹영의 주변에는 그녀를 언제 죽이려 들지 모르는 이들이 있고, 그녀를 좋아하는 이와 그녀가 좋아하는 이 또한 있었다.

길고 긴 환생의 고리 끝, 이제는 마지막 생. 녹영의 이번 생은 다를 수 있을까. 비극 뿐이던 전생에서 벗어날 수 있을까. 전생은 과연 현재 삶에 어떤 의미가 있는 것일까? 

운명 속에 놓인 녹영의 마지막 선택이 시작된다.

description.en: Blessed be the devout who remain chaste among the tainted. A pious young debutante of the Kingdom of Brandt, Elke Eberhardt prays each day as she vies for the sacred title of Pontifex, which grants authority over the nation’s faith. Unfortunately for Elke, fate has other, crueler plans—as she catches the eye of Sir Reiner Mikhel, a notorious womanizer who has seduced countless noblewomen in Brandt. description.en: At the age of eight, Lucian is forced to "marry" an invisible ghost and live in her haunted mansion. Taking pity on Lucian, the ghost secretly cooks and cleans for him, only to discover he can suddenly see her! Once they're closer, Lucian names his ghost bride "Ria" and promises to officially wed her someday. But Lucian is later revealed to be a prince, and the two of them are torn apart shortly after. Years later, the little groom returns as a powerful emperor, ready to sweep his ghost bride off her feet at last.
description.fr:
Je ne faisais que vivre tranquillement, seule, depuis 300 ans, quand tout à coup, des humains ont fait irruption et ont organisé une cérémonie de mariage spirituel sans mon consentement.
Et pour couronner le tout, avec un gamin de 8 ans.

Mais ce gamin-là,  qui ne sait rien faire, n’arrête pas de causer des problèmes et ne mange que des pommes de terre rôties tous les jours… ?

Bon, d’accord. Comme j’ai un peu pitié de lui, je vais lui préparer un petit repas.
Je vais aussi donner un coup de main pour la lessive… et le mettre à la porte dès qu’il aura grandi.

Car je n’ai absolument aucune envie de m’attacher à un humain !

Power, body, charisma all together it shakes the mind. Provoked the gym teacher to seduce his nervous mind. The first kiss then, second kiss to seduce. Who is really the person that makes Chunja's heart thump? That person is…!!  
  
  
As the school outcast, Chun ja has resigned herself to be being bullied, ostracized and just generally ignored. All this changes one day, however, when she becomes involved with the new gym teacher and the school rebel, Seo Lu, and eventually finds herself drawn to both of them.

description.en:
A second chance arrives for Ma Beomtae, whose dream of becoming a hero was shattered by a false accusation. Now, he must debut on a survival program to become a hero.

However, being a K-hero these days isn't as easy as it seems. With a 7-day work week, mandatory donations, constant backstabbing, and colleagues going crazy... Will Ma Beomtae be able to successfully fulfill his hero dream?

Fate draws them together again and old wounds resurface that threatens the lives of everyone around them.

Out of her curiosity, Aram goes to look for the patissierie who was on that show… which will lead her to change the perspective on her life and future.

description.en: A 26-year-old Gong Joo gets trapped in a game a week before her first day at work. Of course, the game works perfectly until the end of the seven-day free trial! You can escape the game only by clearing the lengthy main quest! She falls in love at first sight with a mysterious and handsome man who was attacked by a bird. They decide to join forces and escape together. However, the game world is full of bugs and has frequent lags, which make the game even harder, and the beloved Ok-bun and the other party members start to feel like extra baggage to her. With the feeling of responsibility of having to be the group leader, she silently carries out the main guests in order to escape. "Please let me escape safely! I have to go to work!" A newcomer's desperate escape from a difficult game world in order to get to his new workplace begins!

The protagonist, who is a job seeker, becomes possessed by the Heavenly Demon of the Demonic Cult, and the Murim League devises a plan to gain peace in the martial arts world by breaking the Heavenly Demon's power. Namgung Jin of the Namgung family steps forward as a volunteer...

description.en: Rune is the sole daughter and master of the notorious Valnocia family. She also commands a team of sure-shots and elite mercenaries, which has earned the house a certain enviable reputation. But rumors say Rune possesses a curious ability, and some call her a monster for it. As forces conspire to bring about a dark goal, a new face joins the extended family, uncovering many more mysterious secrets that lurk in the shadows of Valnocia Manor. TappyToon presents the exclusive, worldwide debut of 'Valnocia,' featuring striking artwork and a fresh cast of bold characters.

description.en:
Wealth, beauty, power… Grace had everything in her hands from the day she was born. Then she got herself banished for single-handedly fighting against 17 nobles.
After her yearlong exile, Grace returns to find trouble has found its way into her home – her mother had been driven out of the family, and her father now has a new wife and daughter. But to make the dysfunctional family even worse, Grace’s new stepsister frames her, and the servants openly defy her.
“I’ll show them why I got banished in the first place!”
Can Grace use her wild antics to slam the door shut when trouble comes knocking?

title.en: Hand Over the Money! Underworld Capital

description.en:
The underworld has become a capitalist society.

One must settle their debts, even in death.

“Wait, you’re saying I can’t move on to the afterlife until I settle my debt?”

Cheon Jae-hak died drowning in debt. That news hit him like a ton of bricks right after dying!

Jae-hak, with his taekwondo skills, will join Underworld Capital to collect money from wandering spirits.

From a debtor to the youngest member of a financial firm!

Alright, I’ll earn money and pay off my debt!

A crazy, overpowered occultist who’ll pay off his debt by beating up ghosts!?

Hey, this actually pays pretty well!

Jeong Buldo was once a legend of the Korean underworld. 

But after a decade in prison, he walks free into a world that no longer plays by the old rules. The streets are run by a new wave of criminals known as the MZ Gang who are louder, flashier, and far more reckless.

Though he intended to leave his past behind, he’s pushed to the edge when the youngbloods hurt those around him. Now, it’s time the city remembered who ruled these streets.

Amidst a zombie apocalypse, Vin Yeom, an exterminator, finds a new purpose as an undertaker, specializing in funerals for the infected. 

Within the walls of the quarantine zone, he and his team navigate a treacherous world, providing solace to grieving families. Their company offers a unique but costly service that bridges the gap between life and death, allowing for one last goodbye. 

But in this world of death and despair, secrets linger, and the very loss that led Vin down this path may unearth a conspiracy that will shock the world and perhaps... help him find his way back.

With a mother who is gone more than half of the time, an overworked older sister who's a manhwa artist, and a lazy twin brother who serves only as a hindrance, Mi-Roo is trapped in a constant balancing act of housework and schoolwork. She’s no superhero though, and it will take more than her undaunted determination to stay afloat!
